verdict.rationale: Pausing a workflow for human approval or input is a fair capability to ask of a workflow automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents an approval step, a wait-for-input module, or a way to pause and resume a scenario run. Webhooks, scheduled queue processing and error handlers are related features, not human-in-the-loop gating, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pause a workflow to wait for human approval or input before it continues
